The cause-wise analysis of deaths due to other causes revealed that 27.8%, 26.3%, and 7.5% deaths in 53 cities were due to ‘'Traffic Accidents’ (14,714), Sudden deaths’ (13,955), and ‘Falls’ (3,964) respectively.
